clips.title: The story
paras: On the Thandol Span, a murder exposes a threat to Ironforge's northern road. Ebenezer Rustlocke has been killed, and Rhag Garmason finds that Kam Deepfury has hidden explosives to cut that route.

A recovered document reveals what happened beneath the Thandol Span. Ebenezer Rustlocke was murdered in its substructure, and the papers expose a further act of sabotage. Kam Deepfury, the Dark Iron agitator who first destroyed part of the bridge, has not stopped. His network planted a second cache of heavy munitions just across the northern border in the Arathi Highlands, ready to finish the destruction.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Heavens no! Poor Rustlocke. 'Tis quite a tragedy indeed.

We must not let his death pass in vain. This parchment you discovered indicates that Kam Deepfury, the mastermind behind the original attack, arranged for a cache of explosives to be stashed just across the Thandol Span, in Arathi Highlands.
If those explosives make it to the bridge, our major supply line to the north will be severed! The cache must be destroyed, friend! Return to me when your mission is complete.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The cache of explosives must be destroyed!

clips.title: Completion
paras: The remaining bridge is saved! You have done a great service to King Magni and the people of Khaz Modan.
Now if we can only hold out long enough for reinforcements to show...
